item.title: CLI Reference
item.description:
The lemat-synth command-line tool lets you extract structured synthesis procedures from materials science papers without writing any Python code.

Both commands accept the same key=value overrides, which can be used to change models, prompts, output paths, and other settings. See Quick Reference: All Arguments below.

item.title: Python API
item.description: Everything the lemat-synth command does, you can also do from a Python script or a Jupyter notebook. This page is written for scientists who are comfortable running Python but do not want to read the source code first.

item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description:
This page covers the most common problems encountered when running LeMat-Synth.

Installation problems

ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'llm_synthesis'

Cause: The package has not been installed into your virtual environment.
